title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-13 08:04:16 最新章节：第2584章 先天逆脉圣体
content_zh:
妖墟有大忌，天黑别出村。
残阳西下，落日余烬，半天红。
整个妖墟，都笼罩在死一般宁静中，仿佛有某种大恐怖，正在酝酿。
村口，张楚带着一群大大小小的孩子，紧张的望着远方。
“狩猎队怎么还没回来？马上就要天黑了……”张楚心中担忧，不时看向不远处的简单沙漏。
八岁的虎子站在一块大石头上，向着远方眺望，他是这群孩子里最大的一个，虎头虎脑，一身腱子肉仿佛小牛犊。
忽然，虎子惊喜的大喊起来：“先生，我看到了，青山叔叔带着猎队回来了，他们猎了好大一头野猪！”
虎子用力的张开手臂比划道：“那么大，比小山还大的野猪！”
张楚顿时稍稍松了一口气，神色舒展开来，暗道：“饵料，成功了！”
紧接着，张楚和孩子们看到，远方，一只比大象还大的野猪尸体，被三十几个壮青年用牛筋绳拉着，快速接近。
孩子们顿时开心的欢呼起来：“哦！青山叔叔带着猎队回来喽！”
“这么大的野猪，能吃一整年！”
有小孩子拍着手，神色里全是崇拜：“青山叔叔他们太厉害了！”
童青山，枣叶村猎队的队长，他身材欣长，健硕有力，且枪法出众，是很多孩子的崇拜偶像。
此刻，张楚看了一眼沙漏，紧接着朝远方大喊：“青山，快，要来不及了，今天的夜，来的早！”
那些青壮听到张楚的话，顿时都神色一变，立刻加快了脚步，飞奔起来。
巨大的野猪尸体被猎队拖着狂奔，连大地都在震颤。
忽然，太阳完全落下。
宁静的天地间仿佛绷断了某根弦，可怕的气息陡然降临。
黑暗，仿佛可怕的洪流，从西方淹没过来，一路把山川河流吞噬，追着猎队，向着小山村侵袭过来。

而与此同时，枣叶村的中央，一棵古老的枣树发出朦胧的光。
光纹交织成淡淡的金色光幕，把小村完全笼罩了起来，让小村一片安静祥和。
“快！”张楚拼命的大喊。
一旦被滚滚而来的黑夜洪流淹没，枣叶村的猎队就完了！
孩子们也紧张的失声，惊恐的表情凝固在脸上，生怕猎队被黑色洪流吞噬。
终于，猎队狂奔着，进入了光幕的范围，黑暗瞬间吞没了整个大地。
但还是稍慢了一点，野猪的半个猪屁股，落在了光幕之外。
咚！
一声巨响，狂奔中的野猪尸体突然停住，就好像是黑暗中有一只看不见的手，牢牢抓住了野猪！
童青山的猎队，所有人也被这巨大的力量，扯的摔在地上。
“咔嚓咔嚓……”仿佛是巨大怪物咀嚼骨头的恐怖声音，在黑暗中响起。
所有听到这个声音的人，无不浑身发毛，后背发寒。
很快，声音消失。
张楚急忙大喊：“青山，快，把野猪拖进来，它已经吃完了！”
众人急忙起身，大家合力，再次拖拽野猪尸体。
这一次，野猪尸体直接被拖入了枣叶村。
众人看到，半个野猪屁股上的肉完全消失了，只留下了一些残缺不全的骨头，血淋淋。
众人的脸色一阵发白，甚至心脏砰砰直跳。
“真险！”有人一脸后怕的说道。
也有人松了一口气：“幸好赶着点回来了，这要是再晚一会儿，别说是猎物，就算是人，恐怕也回不来了。”

这时候张楚再次大喊：“快，先把坏的部分切掉！”
虽然张楚也只有二十来岁，与猎队的男人相比，手无缚鸡之力，但童青山却非常听张楚的话，他一刀将部分猪屁股切去，丢入了黑暗之中。
“咔嚓咔嚓……”黑暗中，又是一阵咀嚼的声音。
content_en:
There is a big taboo in the Yaoxu. Do not leave the village after dark.
The setting sun is setting in the west, the embers of the setting sun are burning, and the sky is red for a long time.
The entire demon ruins was shrouded in deathly tranquility, as if some great terror was brewing.
At the entrance of the village, Zhang Chu led a group of children, large and small, looking nervously into the distance.
"Why hasn't the hunting team come back yet? It will be dark soon..." Zhang Chu was worried and looked at the simple hourglass not far away from time to time.
Eight-year-old Huzi stood on a big rock and looked into the distance. He was the oldest of the group of children. He had a tiger head and a tiger head, and his body was as tender as a calf.
Suddenly, Huzi shouted in surprise: "Sir, I saw it. Uncle Qingshan came back with the hunting team. They hunted a big wild boar!"
Huzi opened his arms vigorously and gestured: "Such a big wild boar, bigger than a hill!"
Zhang Chu suddenly breathed a sigh of relief, his expression relaxed, and he secretly said: "The bait is successful!"
Immediately afterwards, Zhang Chu and the children saw, in the distance, a wild boar carcass larger than an elephant, being pulled by more than thirty strong young men with tendon ropes and approaching quickly.
The children immediately cheered happily: "Oh! Uncle Qingshan is back with the hunting team!"
"A wild boar this big can eat for a whole year!"
Some children clapped their hands, their expressions full of admiration: "Uncle Qingshan and the others are so awesome!"
Tong Qingshan, the captain of the hunting team of Zaoye Village, is tall, strong and powerful, and has outstanding marksmanship. He is the idol of many children.
At this moment, Zhang Chu glanced at the hourglass, and then shouted into the distance: "Qingshan, hurry up, it's too late, tonight's night comes early!"
When the young men heard Zhang Chu's words, their expressions suddenly changed, and they immediately quickened their pace and started running.
The huge wild boar carcass was dragged by the hunting team and ran wildly, making the ground tremble.
Suddenly, the sun completely set.
It was as if a string was broken in the tranquil world, and a terrifying aura suddenly descended.
Darkness, like a terrible torrent, flooded in from the west, swallowing up the mountains and rivers, chasing the hunting team, and invaded the small mountain village.
At the same time, in the center of Zaoye Village, an ancient jujube tree glowed dimly.
The light patterns intertwined into a faint golden light curtain, completely covering the small village, making the small village quiet and peaceful.
"Quick!" Zhang Chu shouted desperately.
Once submerged by the rolling torrent of night, the hunting team in Zaoye Village will be doomed!
The children also lost their voices nervously, with frightened expressions on their faces, fearing that the hunting team would be swallowed by the black torrent.
Finally, the hunting team ran wildly and entered the range of the light curtain, and darkness instantly swallowed the entire land.
But it was still a little slower, and half of the wild boar's butt fell outside the light curtain.
Boom!
There was a loud noise, and the running wild boar carcass suddenly stopped, as if an invisible hand in the darkness had firmly grasped the wild boar!
Everyone in Tong Qingshan's hunting team was also pulled to the ground by this huge force.
"Crack, click, click..." The terrifying sound, like a giant monster chewing bones, sounded in the darkness.
Everyone who heard this voice felt hairy all over their bodies and chills on their backs.
Soon, the sound disappeared.
Zhang Chu hurriedly shouted: "Qingshan, hurry up, drag the wild boar in, it has already eaten!"
Everyone stood up in a hurry and worked together to drag the wild boar carcass again.
This time, the wild boar carcass was dragged directly into Zaoye Village.
Everyone saw that the meat on half of the wild boar's butt had completely disappeared, leaving only some incomplete bones and blood.
Everyone's faces turned pale for a while, and their hearts even started pounding.
"It's really dangerous!" someone said with a scared look on his face.
Some people breathed a sigh of relief: "Fortunately, we came back in time. If it had been a little later, let alone prey, even humans would not be able to come back."
At this time, Zhang Chu shouted again: "Quick, cut off the bad part first!"
Although Zhang Chu is only in his twenties,Compared with the men in the hunting team, Tong Qingshan had no power to restrain a chicken, but Tong Qingshan listened to Zhang Chu's words very much. He cut off part of the pig's butt with a knife and threw it into the darkness.
"Crack, click, click..." There was another sound of chewing in the darkness.
